intro.title: Controlled DatePicker
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Controlled DatePicker component in React with TypeScript. You will learn how to manage a selected date as a state variable and update it based on user input from a date input field. The core concept is controlled components, where the component's value is driven by React state and changes are handled via event callbacks. You will use React's useState hook for state management and TypeScript to define the date type. This will help you create interactive, type-safe forms in your React applications.
intro.usecase: Controlled DatePickers are essential in form-heavy applications like booking systems, where users select flight dates, hotel check-in/out times, or appointment scheduling. In financial dashboards, they enable filtering transaction histories by date ranges for reports and analytics. E-commerce platforms use them for delivery date selection during checkout, ensuring data consistency between user input and application state. This pattern gives developers precise control over date validation, formatting, and synchronization with backend APIs.
